offeringVersion.description: Effective offering revision returned by Service Catalog pricing.

catalogVersion.description: Catalog service version captured with the price.

vendorPricingVersion.description: Vendor overlay version captured with the price. Zero means no overlay.

packageId.description: Alias of offeringId for UI compatibility.

visitWindowId.description: Stable id from the offering visitWindows preference list.

autoRenew.description: Customer renewal choice; applied only when true.

totalMinor.description: Final customer price for the selected vehicle after catalog minor→major conversion (INR rupees integer). Must match the resolved offering price.

durationMinutes.description: Package-total duration for the selected vehicle

billingPeriodStart.description: Set when the first job starts

activatedAt.description: Payment completion time (plan may still await first job)

expectedPrice.description: Optional on preview, required on commit.
